observation.command: sleep 20; cd /workspace && docker ps --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}'; echo "=== curl via traefik ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "auth.localhost:3000 -> %{http_code}\n" -H "Host: auth.localhost" http://localhost:3000/health/ready --max-time 10; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "root localhost:3000 -> %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000 --max-time 10
